query: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('task',t.id,'type',t.task_type,'pool',t.pool,'subjectKind',t.subject_kind,'subject',t.subject_id,'state',t.state,'owner',m.owner_id,'created',t.created_at) FROM durable_task t LEFT JOIN meeting m ON t.subject_kind='MEETING' AND m.id=t.subject_id WHERE t.state IN ('READY','RUNNING','RECONCILING') AND (t.pool LIKE 'TASK06%' OR m.owner_id LIKE 'task06%' OR m.owner_id LIKE 'b06-restart-%') ORDER BY t.id;
scope: SELECT-only namespace observation; no cancellation or cleanup
interpretation: READY+RUNNING=182 historical count; including RECONCILING gives205. Two matching b06-restart READY rows predate fix01 and remain untouched.
